subject.title: fix(line): keep replies deliverable when action data or button URLs exceed LINE's size caps

question: For a legal 50-action LINE imagemap whose video external link exceeds LINE's cap, should OpenClaw preserve all 50 valid actions while removing the invalid link without a visible warning, or reserve/drop an action to display an unavailable-link fallback?
rationale: LINE's action cap prevents the branch from both preserving every valid action and adding the same visible fallback used elsewhere; this is a user-visible channel policy tradeoff rather than a mechanical correctness repair.

options.title: Preserve valid imagemap actions
options.body: Keep all 50 valid actions and remove only the invalid external link, accepting that this edge has no visible warning.

options.title: Reserve a visible fallback slot
options.body: Drop or reserve one action so the user receives an unavailable-link message action, trading away a valid imagemap action.

recommendation.title: Preserve valid imagemap actions
recommendation.body: Keep all 50 valid actions and remove only the invalid external link, accepting that this edge has no visible warning.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch history and assignment show direct ownership of the fallback and imagemap policy now under review.
